placemarks.title: Contemporary Irish Art Gallery
placemarks.address: Unit 8-9, Royal Hibernian Way, Dawson Street, Dublin 2, D02 HP82, Dublin
placemarks.description: The RHA is Ireland’s powerhouse of the Arts, steered by an artist-run academy of our time. Our mission is to support artists. We stage free public exhibitions and provide artist-led training in the visual arts.

placemarks.title: Tortoreto Lido beach
placemarks.description: Tortoreto Lido is a beach in the north of Adriatic coast, Abruzzo region, Italy. The key feature is an upscale palmed promenade.

placemarks.title: Inch Beach
placemarks.description: Situated along the beautiful Dingle Peninsula in County Kerry, Inch Beach is a real gem along the Wild Atlantic Way.

placemarks.title: Museo Nacional del Prado
placemarks.address: C. de Ruiz de Alarcón, 23, Retiro, 28014, Madrid
placemarks.description: The Museo Nacional del Prado is one of the most popular and renowned art venues in the world, with 3 million visitors annually and an online presence of over 10 million.

placemarks.title: Louvre Museum
placemarks.description: The Louvre’s collections are an invitation to travel – a celebration of beauty in all its forms and guises, transcending classification. At the Louvre, a small, everyday Egyptian chair is just as much a masterpiece as...
